title: History of AI
description: Trace the major milestones of artificial intelligence—from Turing's question to modern transformers.
learningObjectives: Identify the major milestones in AI history
Explain the AI winters and why they happened
Recognize the shift from symbolic AI to deep learning

content.content: In 1950, Alan Turing published 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' and proposed the Turing Test: can a machine's responses be indistinguishable from a human's?
The term 'Artificial Intelligence' was coined in 1956 at the Dartmouth Conference by John McCarthy and colleagues.
Turing Test: A test of a machine's ability to exhibit intelligent behavior equivalent to a human.
Early AI promised too much. When results failed to materialize, funding dried up—twice. These periods are called 'AI Winters'.
The first AI Winter (1974-1980) followed the failure of machine translation. The second (1987-1993) followed the collapse of the expert systems market.
Expert systems like MYCIN were impressive but too expensive and brittle to maintain at scale.
In 2012, AlexNet won the ImageNet competition by a huge margin using deep convolutional neural networks. This sparked the modern AI boom.
Key breakthroughs followed: word embeddings, attention mechanisms, transformers (2017), and finally large language models like GPT.
The shift was not incremental—it was a fundamental change in how AI systems learn: from hand-coded rules to learning from massive datasets.

items.question: What were the 'AI Winters'?
options: Periods when AI funding dried up after failed promises
items.explanation: AI Winters were periods of reduced funding after AI failed to deliver on early promises.

items.question: Why was AlexNet 2012 significant?
items.answer: It demonstrated that deep CNNs could dramatically outperform previous methods, sparking the modern deep learning era.
items.explanation: AlexNet won ImageNet 2012 by a huge margin, proving the power of deep learning.

notes.summary: AI history spans from Turing's 1950 question to modern transformers, passing through two AI Winters.

keyTakeaways: AI has 70+ years of history, with major breakthroughs and collapses.
The shift from symbolic AI to deep learning changed everything.
Understanding history prevents repeating past mistakes.
